item.title: Discover Oregon’s Best Bubbles at the Inaugural Method Oregon Grand Tasting | Visit McMinnville
item.description: Oregon’s sparkling wine moment has arrived. On July 26, the inaugural Method Oregon Grand Tasting at Domaine Willamette will bring together the state’s top producers and industry trailblazers for a day of world-class bubbles, expert insights, and unforgettable tasting experiences in the heart of the Dundee Hills. Don’t miss your chance to sip, learn, and celebrate the rise of Oregon sparkling wine.

item.title: Alt Wine Remixed: A Wild Night of Wine (Minus the Pinot) Hits McMinnville’s Art Alley | Visit McMinnville
item.description: Alt Wine Remixed is a one-night-only wine party in McMinnville’s Art Alley celebrating Oregon’s boldest, weirdest, and most wonderful non-Pinot Noir wines—complete with tacos, vinyl, and zero pretension.

item.description: From freshly planted flower beds to a fresh crop of small businesses, McMinnville is bursting with new life. item.title: Where to Beat the Heat in McMinnville | Visit McMinnville
item.description: McMinnville may be known for its wine, but savvy summer travelers know it’s also full of low-key ways to beat the heat. From shady riverbanks to frosty scoops and naturally chilled tasting rooms, the key is slowing down and following the breeze. Locals head for Joe Dancer Park or the Nestucca River when the mercury climbs, while visitors often find sweet relief inside the Evergreen waterpark—or with a cold glass of Pinot at Maysara. item.description: The Atticus Hotel’s Artist in Residency program returns this winter with a literary focus, offering writers space, support, and a warm welcome into McMinnville’s creative community in partnership with Linfield University.

item.title: Beyond Pinot: Savoring McMinnville's Diverse Culinary and Beverage Scene | Visit McMinnville
item.description: Beyond Pinot McMinnville is more than world-class Pinot. Discover bold wines, craft beers, artisan spirits, and inventive eats in a town that knows how to pour creativity into every glass.

item.title: It’s a Great Day to Be a Wildcat! | Visit McMinnville
item.description: McMinnville’s charm reveals itself quickly, and one of its cornerstones is Linfield University. While our award-winning wineries and vibrant downtown often take the spotlight, Linfield is much more than a college campus. Since 1858, it has been a living part of McMinnville’s identity, with its oak-lined walkways, historic brick buildings, and a calendar full of cultural, athletic, and intellectual events that enrich both residents and visitors. item.title: The Passion for Pinot | Visit McMinnville
item.description: McMinnville sits in the heart of Oregon wine country, where Pinot Noir reigns supreme. First cultivated in France over 2,000 years ago, this notoriously finicky grape thrives in the Willamette Valley’s cool climate and soils. In the 1960s, local pioneers saw the similarities to Burgundy and proved the world wrong—by 1979, Oregon Pinot was competing with France’s best. Today, Pinot Noir makes up 60% of Oregon vineyards. item.title: Family-Friendly Autumn in McMinnville — 2025 Edition | Visit McMinnville
item.description: Experience fall in McMinnville with pumpkin patch adventures, leaf-lined park strolls, and afternoons of art and culture. In October, downtown glows with Scarecrows on a Lamp Post and culminates in the family-favorite Trick-or-Treat on Third Street, October 31, 2025. Crisp air, golden leaves, and festive traditions make autumn in McMinnville unforgettable.
